title: TikTok Spark Ads: What They Are and How to Use Them
summary: What TikTok Spark Ads are, how to get a Spark Ads code, how to launch them in Ads Manager and how they work with GMV Max for TikTok Shop sellers.
body_markdown:
TikTok Spark Ads turn an organic TikTok post into an ad. The post can come from your own account or from a creator who gives you permission. Every like, comment, share and follow the ad earns stays on that original post, so the paid boost keeps working after the campaign ends.


This guide covers how Spark Ads differ from regular ads, how to get a Spark Ads code from a creator, how to set one up in TikTok Ads Manager and how Spark Ads fit with GMV Max if you sell through TikTok Shop.


## What are TikTok Spark Ads?


TikTok's[About Spark Ads](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/spark-ads?lang=en) page describes them as "a native ad format that allows you to leverage organic TikTok posts and their features in your advertising." Instead of uploading a separate ad video, you put budget behind a post that already lives on TikTok.


You can publish Spark Ads in two ways:


- From your own TikTok account. You boost your brand's organic posts.
- From creators' accounts. You boost a creator's organic post, with their authorization.


TikTok says Spark Ads ensure "that all views, comments, shares, likes, and follows gained from boosting the video during the promotion are attributed to your organic posts." Spark Ads have been available worldwide "since the global launch of Spark Ads in July of 2021."


## Spark Ads vs regular in-feed ads


A regular (non-Spark) ad is a video uploaded to Ads Manager. It sends people to your landing page or app, and that's about it. A Spark Ad behaves like the organic post it came from.


On a Spark Ad, viewers can:


- Click the CTA button or the caption to go to your landing page.
- Tap the profile photo or nickname, or swipe left, to visit the account that posted the video.
- Tap the "+" on the profile photo to follow that account.
- Tap the sound to open its music page.


On a non-Spark ad, the CTA, profile photo, nickname, caption and swipe left all lead to the landing page or app install page.


That difference shows up in the reporting too. Spark Ads track metrics that regular ads don't, including paid followers, paid profile visits, music clicks and anchor clicks. TikTok counts paid likes, comments, shares and follows when they happen "within 1 day of a user seeing a paid ad."


## Why brands use Spark Ads


TikTok lists three benefits for Spark Ads:


- Brand trust. Organic posts in your ads help "build and establish your brand image and brand trust."
- Creator reach with less production. You can use "creator content and audience to drive campaign performance with fewer resources."
- Lasting impact. The results continue "beyond the campaign since all of the Spark Ads post engagement will be attributed to the original organic post."


The last point matters most over time. A regular ad's likes and comments disappear when the campaign stops. A Spark Ad's engagement stays on the post, so the next person who finds it organically sees the social proof the ad helped build. If you boost your own posts, the followers you gain stay on your account too.


There's also a practical reason. Spark Ads let you put money behind videos that have already proven themselves organically, so you're scaling something that works rather than testing from zero.


## Should you boost your own posts or a creator's?


TikTok's[Spark Ads 101 guide](https://ads.tiktok.com/business/en-US/blog/spark-ads-101-make-tiktoks-into-ads) gives clear scenarios for each.


Boost your brand's own organic posts when:


- "You want to build social presence fast on TikTok and grow your following"
- "You have a mix of marketing objectives, and want to retarget followers later in lower-funnel campaigns"
- "You're running an always-on strategy that combines organic and paid methods"


Boost a creator's organic posts when:


- "You want to scale your campaign with the impact of TikTok creators"
- "You want to add paid traffic to your branded creator content to maximize ROI from your partnership"
- "You need to supply a campaign with high-quality, native-feeling branded videos"


Most brands end up doing both. Your own posts build your account, and creator posts bring new audiences and the kind of native content that's hard to make in-house. TikTok lets you select creatives from more than one identity instead of just one at a time, so you can test brand and creator posts side by side.


## How to get a Spark Ads code


To run a creator's post as a Spark Ad, you need their authorization. The usual route is a video code: a code the creator generates for one post and shares with you.


### Creator steps


[TikTok's steps for creators](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/how-to-create-spark-ads-for-smart-campaigns-on-tiktok-ads-manager?lang=en) , in the TikTok app:


1. Make sure Authorized Posts are allowed in the profile settings: Settings and Privacy > Privacy, or Me > Creator tools.
2. Open the post to authorize and tap the three dots.
3. Tap Ad settings.
4. Agree to the Advertising Content Terms of Service.
5. Turn on the Ad authorization toggle.
6. Generate a video code.
7. Select the authorization duration.
8. Tap Copy Code and send it to the brand.


If you work with creators often, it helps to send them these steps with your brief. It saves a round of back-and-forth for every post.


### Choosing an authorization duration


TikTok lets the creator choose an authorization period of "7, 30, 60, or 365 days." TikTok says you can "customize the duration of your authorization code to meet campaign needs and minimize costs."


TikTok doesn't say which length to pick, so here's how we'd think about it. Match the code to your full campaign plus time to test and scale. A code that runs out mid-campaign stops the ad just as you've learned which posts work. If you're paying creators for usage rights, agree on the duration before they generate the code, since longer usage is usually worth more to both sides. Ads Manager shows the authorization period beneath each post, so check it before you build a campaign around a video.


### Duets and Stitches


A Duet or Stitch features two creators, so it needs two codes. TikTok's steps: enter the second creator's code first. "When the system confirms this is a dual creator post," enter the code from the first creator's original post. Ask for both codes up front so the ad isn't held up.


## How to set up Spark Ads in TikTok Ads Manager


TikTok's[Spark Ads Creation Guide](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/spark-ads-creation-guide?lang=en) covers manual and search campaigns. There are two ways to add a Spark Ad: pull an existing post, or push a new one.


To start either:


1. Log in to TikTok Ads Manager and go to the Campaign tab.
2. Click +Create and select an advertising objective.
3. Complete your campaign and ad group settings.
4. In the Ad creatives section (called Creative assets for some advertisers), click + Add videos or images.


### Pull an existing post


Use this for posts already on your account, an account authorized through Business Center, or a creator's post shared by video code.


1. Choose the TikTok posts tab, select the post and click Confirm.
2. To add a creator's post, click Add post and enter the video code. You can authorize up to 20 video codes at a time, and the authorization period shows beneath each post.
3. Complete the ad details, destination and optional tracking.
4. Click Publish all.


You can also add a creator's code ahead of time. In Ads Manager, go to Tools, then Creative library under the Creative tab. Click Spark ads posts, then Apply for Authorization, and paste the video code.


### Push a new post


Use this to publish a new video from Ads Manager to a TikTok account linked for Spark Ads.


1. Choose the Your Library tab, select the creatives and click Confirm.
2. Complete the ad details: identity, music, text, call to action, destination and optional tracking.
3. Click Publish all.


TikTok supports Spark Ads across most objectives. With auction buying, that's Reach, Traffic, Video Views, Community interaction, App promotion, Conversions, Lead generation and Sales. Reach & Frequency buying supports Reach, Traffic and Video Views.


## Spark Ads for TikTok Shop and GMV Max


If you sell through TikTok Shop, setup works differently. TikTok's[Spark Ads reporting page](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/key-reporting-metrics-spark-ads-video-shopping-ads?lang=en) explains: "To create ads using the Sales objective and your TikTok Shop as the sales destination, you can create a GMV Max campaign." Since July 2025, GMV Max has been the only supported campaign type for TikTok Shop Ads. Spark Ads still matter for TikTok Shop sellers, but they work through GMV Max.


GMV Max is TikTok's automated campaign for TikTok Shop. You choose the products, an ROI target and a budget, and the system chooses which videos to run. Spark Ads come in as creatives:


- Creator posts by video code. In your GMV Max campaign, open the editing page, click Manage creatives, then Add posts, and choose Add video codes([TikTok's guide to GMV Max creatives](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/how-to-make-creative-assets-available-for-your-product-gmv-max-campaign?lang=en) ). The creator's steps for generating the code are the same as above.
- Affiliate videos **.** TikTok's[Product GMV Max guide](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/about-product-gmv-max?lang=en) says "GMV Max automatically includes authorized affiliate videos that feature your selected products." If a video you want doesn't appear, you can ask the creator for authorization or add it by video code.
- Your own accounts. GMV Max also draws on videos from your TikTok accounts connected to your shop.


Spark Ads for TikTok Shop come with shop metrics in the Reporting tab of Ads Manager, including product page views, checkouts initiated, adds to cart, purchases, gross revenue and return on ad spend.


In practice, your job with Spark Ads on TikTok Shop is finding and authorizing the posts worth backing, while GMV Max decides how much each one gets. Our guide to[TikTok GMV Max](https://www.pattern.com/blog/tiktok-gmv-max) covers ROI targets, setup and how GMV Max counts sales.


## Rules and limits to know before you launch


TikTok sets a few rules for Spark Ads that are easy to miss:


- Video length. "There is a 10 minute maximum on videos that can be sparked." There are no restrictions on aspect ratio, resolution, file type or file size.
- Captions. "You cannot edit a post's caption after it's been authorized as an ad." The ad's display name and text come from the organic post. Ad captions can be left blank.
- Private videos. "A private video will become public once it is used in a campaign, and the video privacy status cannot be changed during promotion."
- Banned posts. Organic posts that have been banned are rejected in Ads Manager too.
- Deleting posts. "Videos need to be un-authorized as a Spark Ad before it can be deleted from the organic account."
- Deleting codes. "A video code can only be deleted when all the ads this video is used in are deleted in TikTok Ads Manager."
- Account limit. Each Ads Manager account supports up to 10,000 Spark Ads.
- Mixing formats. You can combine Spark Ads and non-Spark ads in the same ad group.


## Which metrics show a Spark Ad is working


Start with the metric that matches your objective, then use the Spark Ads metrics to see what the ad is doing for the post and the account:


- Paid followers. New followers gained within 1 day of someone seeing the ad. This shows whether the ad is growing the account.
- Paid profile visits. Profile visits the ad drove during the campaign.
- Paid likes, comments and shares. Engagement within 1 day of seeing the ad.
- Anchor clicks and anchor click rate. Clicks on the anchor in your Spark Ads video in the For You feed, and clicks per anchor impression.
- Music clicks. Clicks on the music disc icon and title.


For TikTok Shop, add the shop events: product page views, checkouts initiated, purchases and ROAS. A post can earn plenty of likes and still not sell. The shop events tell you which videos drive orders.


## Tips for choosing videos to spark


TikTok's advice is to back videos that already work: "Choose videos that have garnered strong organic performance whether it be a high number of views, likes, comments or shares." Beyond that, TikTok's Spark Ads guide recommends:


- Pick videos that reinforce your brand message, and look beyond your own category for creators whose content suits your audience.
- Plan a range of content, from trends to product tutorials, to cover each stage of the shopping journey.
- Keep it authentic and positive **.** TikTok says almost all of the best-performing Spark Ads tell their stories in emotionally appealing ways.
- Get the sound right **.** TikTok is a sound-on platform, and many top trends have a catchy track.
- Build on current trends, and move quickly. TikTok's guide notes that "The TikTok community values timeliness over perfection!"
- Use short text overlays to tell the story in TikTok's fast, visual style.
- Talk to the viewer directly. Some of the top Spark Ads show creators demonstrating a product as if in conversation with the audience.


## Common Spark Ads mistakes


- Letting the code run out mid-campaign. Agree on a duration that covers the campaign and testing time before the creator generates the code.
- Authorizing a caption with errors. It can't be edited afterwards, so check it first.
- Sparking a private video by accident. It becomes public once it's used in a campaign.
- Forgetting the second code on a Duet or Stitch. Both creators need to authorize it.
- Choosing videos on views alone. Views show reach. For sales, look at the shop events too.
- Running Shop ads outside GMV Max. Ads with the Sales objective and TikTok Shop as the destination are created as GMV Max campaigns.

## TikTok Spark Ads FAQ


### What is a Spark Ad on TikTok?


A Spark Ad is an organic TikTok post used as an ad. It can come from your own account or from a creator who authorizes it. The engagement it earns, including likes, comments, shares and follows, stays on the original post.


### How do I get a Spark Ads code?


The creator generates it in the TikTok app. They open the post, tap the three dots, go to Ad settings, turn on Ad authorization, generate a video code, choose a duration and tap Copy Code. You then add the code in TikTok Ads Manager.


### How long does a Spark Ads code last?


The creator chooses 7, 30, 60 or 365 days when generating the code. Pick a duration that covers your full campaign, including time to test and scale.


### Can you use Spark Ads with GMV Max?


Yes. In a GMV Max campaign, go to Manage creatives > Add posts > Add video codes to add a creator's post. GMV Max also includes authorized affiliate videos that feature your selected products.


### Do Spark Ads cost more than regular ads?


Spark Ads don't have a separate price. You buy them like other TikTok ads, through auction or Reach & Frequency buying, with your own budget and bid settings. Our guide to[TikTok ads cost](https://www.pattern.com/blog/tiktok-ads-cost) covers how TikTok prices ads and the budgets it recommends.
